:::{#thm-pois-score}
#### Score function of a Poisson variable

Let $X \sim \Pois(\rate)$, with mean $\rate$ and observed count $x$.
The [score](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-score) $\score$ of the single observation $x$
is the derivative of its log-likelihood $\loglik$ with respect to $\rate$.
It equals the deviation of $x$ from the mean $\E{X}$,
divided by the variance $\Var{X}$:

$$\score = \frac{x - \E{X}}{\Var{X}} = \frac{x - \rate}{\rate}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-pois-score-fn, worked in @sol-pois-score-fn.

:::
